description: 0x012F test-bus sweep on the XIAO + Wio-LR2021: bus bits 7, 8, 11 routed to pads DIO7/DIO8/DIO11 (params: selector, A=0x0980, B=0x0980, C=0). Per selector and pad: edges counted in hardware, high fraction from port sampling, level at the end. Windows: 60 ms (standby, rx_idle), 150 ms (rx_idle_150ms, rx_packets). Receiver: LoRa 908 MHz / 62.5 kHz / SF7, continuous RX. rx_packets: the second board sending 200-byte LoRa packets every ~220 ms.
